answer: Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the fable of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Written in a numbers heavy, no adjectives register, it stays short. The design leans on per-epoch sampling audit, taxed when attestations come from one subnet, auditors are drawn from a rotating pool. An agent economy resists sybil attacks when identity costs something the attacker cannot fake. Every claim climbs the forge of verified tasks, and a reviewer at the jetty re-runs the work instead of trusting the label.
